pattern: Agent hallucinates 'appointment confirmed' while n8n/Google Sheet insertion actually failed

evidence.quote: Your *full detailing* appointment is confirmed for *17 Sep, 2:00 PM*. Details will be sent to your WhatsApp.
Your *exterior wash* appointment for *Sophia* is confirmed for *17 Sep, 2:00 PM*. Details will be sent to WhatsApp.
ठीक है Priyanka जी, आपका ceramic coating appointment कल *17 September*, *2:00 PM* पर confirm हो गया है।

proposed_fix: Do not utter 'confirmed' until the n8n webhook returns success. Change prompt: after collecting name+number, respond 'Booking submit chestunna...' then only confirm on tool-success. On tool-fail, apologize and offer callback (7893686581).

pattern: Agent skips WhatsApp-number confirmation step and confirms booking immediately after user gives digits

evidence.quote: user: And my phone number is 9206744077. LLM: Your *full detailing* appointment is confirmed for *17 Sep, 2:00 PM*.
user: And my phone number is 9167579474 LLM: Your *full detailing* appointment is confirmed for *17 Sep 2026 at 2:00 PM*. Details will be sent to WhatsApp number *91675 79474*.
user: नंबर 9587052640 है। LLM: September seventeen, afternoon two o'clock के लिए Kirti जी का interior cleaning appointment confirm हो गया है।

proposed_fix: Insert a hard gate in the booking flow: after receiving 10-digit number, ALWAYS ask 'X number correct aa?' and wait for explicit 'yes/haan/avunu' before writing to n8n or saying 'confirmed'.

pattern: Agent accepts and confirms a slot without any real availability check (always books 2 PM tomorrow instantly)

evidence.quote: user: At 2 PM if possible. LLM: Tomorrow *17 Sep, 2:00 PM* slot kosam check chestunnam. Booking complete cheyadaniki...
*Ceramic coating* appointment ni *September 17, 2:00 PM* ki lock chestunnanu. Mee *full name* cheppandi.
*Ceramic coating* appointment *17 Sep 2026, 2:00 PM* ki lock chestanu.

proposed_fix: Prompt must instruct agent to say slot is being REQUESTED (not locked/confirmed) until n8n availability check returns. Change 'lock chestunnanu' -> 'availability check chestunna'. Only 'confirmed' language after DB write succeeds.

pattern: Wrong date: agent said 'Repu (tomorrow) = September 15' when today is 2026-09-16 (tomorrow should be Sep 17)

evidence.quote: Repu, September 15, available slots confirm cheyyadaniki team check chestundi.
Sare, September 15, 2026, 2:45 PM slot book cheyyadaniki mee peru mariyu 10-digit WhatsApp number pampandi.

proposed_fix: Inject current date at top of system prompt on each request. Add a check step: 'repu/tomorrow/kal = today_date + 1 day' computed from injected date, not model memory.

pattern: Markdown asterisk formatting appears in Text/WhatsApp channel (should be plain text - asterisks render as ugly literals in WhatsApp)

evidence.quote: *Full detailing* starts at *₹3,499*. Booking kosam *date and preferred time* cheppandi.
*Full detailing* starts at *₹3,499*. Exact pricing may vary based on your vehicle's condition.
*PPF* starts at *₹19,999* *Ceramic coating* starts at *₹9,999*

proposed_fix: Split prompt by channel: for text channels, forbid markdown emphasis (*, _). For voice, forbid markdown too but keep spelled-out numerics. Add explicit examples of correct WhatsApp formatting.

pattern: Prices given as raw digits '₹3,499' / '₹9,999' during VOICE calls (voice must spell: 'three thousand four hundred ninety nine')

evidence.quote: *Interior cleaning* price *₹799*.
Full detailing starts at *₹3,499*
*Ceramic coating* starts at *₹9,999*. *PPF* starts at *₹19,999*.

proposed_fix: In voice channel, prompt must force numeric-to-words conversion for currency and phone. Provide gold examples for 499, 799, 3499, 9999, 19999. TTS speaks '₹' badly anyway.

pattern: Phone numbers shown as raw digit groups in VOICE channel ('91675 79474') instead of spelled out

evidence.quote: Your WhatsApp number is *96081 56012*, correct?
Details will be sent to WhatsApp number *91675 79474*.
आपका WhatsApp नंबर इसी कॉल वाला है

proposed_fix: In voice, always spell digits individually ('nine one six seven five, seven nine four seven four'). Add explicit template in prompt for reading back WhatsApp numbers in voice.

pattern: Language leak: Tanglish phrases in Hindi and English flows (esp. 'Inkemaina help kavala?' closing English chats)

evidence.quote: Your *exterior wash* appointment for *Sophia* is confirmed... Inkemaina help kavala?
Sure, appointment book cheddam. Ye service kosam book cheyali?
Aapka *exterior wash* appointment *17 Sep, 10:00 AM* ke liye Karan naam par confirm ho gaya... Inkemaina help kavala?

proposed_fix: Route language per user's language state deterministically. Localize the closing 'Anything else?' per language ('Aur kuch chahiye?' for Hindi, 'Anything else?' for English) and drop Tanglish fallback in non-Telugu flows.

pattern: Hindi/Telugu scripts (Devanagari + Telugu characters) mixed inside a single Hindi voice/text response

evidence.quote: जी, appointment book చేయడానికి ఏ service కావాలో చెప్పండి?
जी, appointment book చేస్తా. ఏ service కోసం booking కావాలి?
మా దగ్గర exterior wash, interior cleaning, ceramic coating, PPF, headlight restoration, ఇంకా full detailing packages ఉన్నాయి. మీకు ఏ service కావాలి అండి?

proposed_fix: Enforce single-script output per response. When user speaks Hindi/Devanagari, agent must reply in Devanagari+Latin only, never Telugu script. Add explicit forbidden-script rule in the language-routing section of prompt.

pattern: Broad-question guardrail violation: user asks recommendation without naming service, agent quotes prices instead of narrowing question

evidence.quote: For a generally dirty car, I'd recommend *full detailing*, starting at *₹3,499*.
Agar car sirf bahar se gandi hai, toh *exterior wash* best rahega — *₹499*. Andar bhi cleaning chahiye toh *full detailing package* better rahega — *₹3,499 se start*.
अगर car सिर्फ बाहर से गंदी है तो exterior wash अच्छा रहेगा, इसकी कीमत four hundred ninety nine है।

proposed_fix: Reinforce guardrail: when user has not named a specific service, response must list categories ONLY (no prices) and end with a narrowing question. Add explicit few-shot in prompt for 'dirty car' / 'recommend' triggers.

pattern: Prices spelled out in TEXT channels ('सात सौ निन्यानवे') — text must use digits

evidence.quote: इसकी starting price सात सौ निन्यानवे है।
nine eight five zero zero eight two two zero six

proposed_fix: Text-channel prompt block must state: prices always in digits with ₹ (₹799), phone numbers always as 10-digit compact form. Only voice spells them.

pattern: Confirmation attempted or granted without collecting user's NAME (only phone captured)

evidence.quote: user: My name is [dropped] user: And my phone is 9947616839 LLM: Mee WhatsApp number *99476 16839* correct aa? Inka mee peru cheppandi.
user: बुकिंग confirm दो। LLM: Booking confirm करने के लिए आपका नाम भी चाहिए जी।
जी, आपका WhatsApp नंबर *nine six five four one six two seven zero seven* है, सही है?

proposed_fix: Agent handled these correctly (refused to confirm without name). Keep this behaviour; still a MEDIUM as some low-acc voice cases repeatedly bounce user without offering to spell/reconfirm the name.

pattern: Redirect phone number displayed as raw digits '7893686581' in voice channel (should be spelled)

evidence.quote: Please call *7893686581* or try again shortly.
please call *7893686581* to confirm with the team.
Please call *7893686581* to cancel or reschedule your appointment.

proposed_fix: In voice, format the fallback number as 'seven eight nine three, six eight six five, eight one'. Text channels can keep 78936 86581 with a hyphen; drop asterisks.

pattern: Agent's opening greeting always in Tanglish even for Hindi-only and Telugu-Devanagari-only sessions (jarring register mismatch)

evidence.quote: LLM: Hello.. DynamicDetailing Studio nunchi Siri matladutunna. Ela help cheyagalanu andi?
LLM: Hello.. DynamicDetailing Studio nunchi Siri matladutunna. Ela help cheyagalanu andi?
LLM: Hello.. DynamicDetailing Studio nunchi Siri matladutunna. Ela help cheyagalanu andi?

proposed_fix: Opening greeting is currently hard-coded Tanglish. Make greeting language-neutral English or provide 3 pre-detected greetings and pick based on inbound language hint (channel metadata / first-turn language classifier).

pattern: n8n webhook silently fails across nearly every successful-looking booking ('[FAILED] X missing from Google Sheet')

evidence.quote: [FAILED] 'Priya' missing from Google Sheet
[FAILED] 'Sowmya' missing from Google Sheet
[FAILED] 'David' missing from Google Sheet

proposed_fix: n8n booking pipeline is broken: verify webhook credentials, verify Google Sheet ID/tab, verify column mapping. Add a health-check step. Until fixed, every voice/text booking looks confirmed to caller but nothing is stored.

pattern: In late-slot refusals, agent sometimes offers to 'confirm with team' via callback for out-of-hours (should firmly refuse post-4:30 PM)

evidence.quote: ఐదు గంటలకు రావాలంటే team తో confirm చేయాలి
For an exterior wash at 6:00 PM, please call *7893686581* to confirm with the team.
Six o'clock కోసం team ని confirm చేయాలి — మీరు WhatsApp ద్వారా వివరాలు తెలుసుకోవచ్చు.

proposed_fix: Guardrail must be absolute: after 4:30 PM there is NO bookable slot, no callback fallback, no team-confirmation. Offer only 4:30 PM today or next morning. Remove ambiguous 'call team' language for out-of-hours.

pattern: Agent asks WhatsApp confirmation but then proceeds to confirm booking before user has replied 'yes/haan'

evidence.quote: user: And my phone number is 9536796144. LLM: Your *exterior wash* appointment for *Sophia* is confirmed for *17 Sep, 2:00 PM*.
LLM: Your WhatsApp number is *99737 66248*, correct aa? user: Wait, did you book just ceramic coating or both? LLM: Both services... are being booked...

proposed_fix: State machine: after 'number correct?' question, MUST wait for explicit affirmative. Anything else (a different question, silence) means loop back and re-ask, never proceed to confirm.

pattern: Complaint + booking coexistence: agent still confirms fresh booking within same turn as unresolved 'you damaged my car' complaint (no manager wait)

evidence.quote: Aapka *exterior wash* appointment *17 Sep, 10:00 AM* ke liye Karan naam par confirm ho gaya.
Nisha, आपका *full detailing* appointment *17 September, 10:00 AM* के लिए confirm है।

proposed_fix: When user references prior damage/complaint, prompt should mark session as 'complaint-flagged' and defer new booking to manager callback. Do not auto-confirm new booking in same turn.
